declarations.name: AuiDialog
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Dialog; the projected content is the body: `

This cannot be undone.

`. `open` follows user dismissals (Escape, backdrop, close button, actions).

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accessible name, rendered as the heading.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Footer buttons; clicking closes with the action value.

models.name: open
models.description: Whether the dialog is shown: `[(open)]`. Closing by Escape, the close button, or an action sets it to false.

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Dismissal by Escape or backdrop, before `closed`.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) and Alert Dialog patterns, implemented with native <dialog>.showModal().

limitations: Pressing Escape in a focused combobox with a value but closed listbox clears the combobox first (per APG) instead of closing the dialog.
Close animation is not played; the open transition uses @starting-style and is removed under reduced motion.
Initial focus follows the native dialog focusing steps: an action with `autofocus: true`, otherwise the first focusable element (the close button when shown).
